description: This PHP class provides internal functions and rules for evaluating endpoints in AWS SDK, including IP validation, URL parsing, string operations, and rule resolution.

classes.name: RulesetStandardLibrary
classes.description: Defines utility functions for endpoint rule evaluation, including IP validation, URL parsing, template resolution, and rule execution.

methods.name: is_set
methods.description: Checks if a value is set.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Implements logical NOT operation.

methods.name: getAttr
methods.description: Retrieves nested attributes from data based on a dot notation path.

methods.description: Returns a substring from the input string, with option to reverse the slice.

methods.name: uriEncode
